name: Atlasbound
subtitle: Location-based exploration RPG
description: Walk, run, cycle, or drive to discover hexagonal map tiles. Revisiting awards familiarity XP. Sideload via AltStore or SideStore.

apps.name: Atlasbound
apps.subtitle: Discover the world, one hex at a time
apps.localizedDescription:
Atlasbound is a location-based exploration RPG for iPhone.

• Reveal one shared hex atlas with Quick or optional automatic exploration
• Follow daily landmark treasure trails and unlock weekly vaults
• Collect themed relics and earn familiarity XP
• Optionally track walks, rides, and other activities
• Frontier expeditions, Pinpoint guessing, and Atlas Stats
• All progress stored on-device

privacy.name: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Atlasbound uses your location to discover map tiles, guide treasure hunts, and optionally track activities.

privacy.name: NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Atlasbound can continue an activity or optional automatic exploration while the screen is locked. Location is used on-device for tile discovery and treasure arrivals.
